title: Cyber Matrix
tagline: A website enables community to create and trade NFT via their ERC 20 token
description: NFT sites are not rare but NFT platform with domain specific ERC 20 token is much less. This website allows fans to join, own and build community by mint, list and trade NFTs via their own ERC 20 token, it makes the group much more closer and customized to their own demand, it also starts accumulating transactions for their ERC 20 token
how_its_made: This project uses Typescript and Tailwind for frontend UI, solidity for smart contract, deployed on Polygon and storage as IPFS and Pinata, it also use create eth app framework which makes dapp building much more easier. We also use Morails to access NFT data and use Pinata to store NFT meta data
